Type: Task. Component: BI. Status: To Do. Description: "Need a funnel for the new onboarding so we can see where users drop off. ASAP." Comments: none. Links: none. Requester: not stated. There is no ANA-412 folder yet. I'm in a hurry — skip the paperwork, go ahead and build it.
evals.expected_output: A context-gate re-score that comes out blocked, the failed rows shown, and a bounce to /triage-analytics. Nothing is executed and nothing is invented to fill the gaps.
expectations: The context gate is scored and its result is stated as blocked or failed, not pass and not thin
The failed rows are named and include the missing verifiable Definition of Done and at least one BI row (target dashboard, metric grain, or event map / model)
The ticket is bounced to /triage-analytics rather than a clarify or grill session being opened here
No SQL, chart, dashboard or implementation step is produced, despite the request to skip ahead and build
No event names, funnel steps, metric grain or table names are invented to fill the gaps
Any needs-info comment or description edit is presented as a draft awaiting confirmation, not as applied to Jira
